svg.title: China's and India's shares of the world article total rose, while the US and Japan's fell
svg.desc: Slope chart: China's and India's shares of the world article total rose, while the US and Japan's fell: in 2000: United States: 28.62%, China: 4.98%, India: 2.00%, Japan: 9.02%, Germany: 6.51%, United Kingdom: 7.28%, South Korea: 1.48%, Türkiye: 0.64%; in 2023: United States: 13.17%, China: 28.51%, India: 6.98%, Japan: 2.95%, Germany: 3.33%, United Kingdom: 2.98%, South Korea: 2.19%, Türkiye: 1.53%.
